title: Shadow's of The Deep chapter one
description: The horrors that live in the dark and deep of caves and the ocean
body:
WARNING, this is a horror mod and also an epilepsy warning, as the Cavecry uses the darkness effect a lot, and the kraken makes the weather stormy, among other things that change lighting fast

 

 

 

The horrors that live in the dark and deep of caves and the ocean

 

The Cavecry is an invisible shadow that cannot see the sky and hunts players who mine in the caves. It has powers over darkness.

 

The Angler is a large monster of the sea that can grab the player and drag them out of boats, but if you can take a few down, you can use the fangs they drop to make a weapon and a necklace as a note You probably need at least iron armor to beat it.

 

The Creeptus is a new type of creeper that hides as a cactus, but unlike it's cousin, it doesn't explode, it shoots thorns.

 

The Kraken is a boss that requires the Criptid Finder Mk1 to find it. It is an endgame boss that is hard to kill and has 3 phases, and drops a Prize bag that gives a bunch of items, including a new food type, Calamari.

 

new tools

 

A new sword, The Leiomano, is made of angler fangs and does 6 damage and has an attack speed of 1. it gives the wither effect to what it hits.

 

The Fang Necklace is made of an angler's fang and gold. It makes you swim faster.

 

The Shiptool is made of 2 Fang Blocks (that are made of 9 angler fangs) and 5 wood planks. If you use it in the ocean, it will place a ship
